errors.evidence: The machine-generated description reports the accuracy for 异常识别 as 0.6992, but the figure shows 0.692.

The reference description explicitly states the chart presents the distribution of training set quantity, validation set quantity, and accuracy for different recognition and reasoning tasks. The machine-generated description omits this specific purpose, only mentioning a general 'comparison'.
The reference description mentions that the left y-axis (quantity) and right y-axis (accuracy) are both on linear scales. The machine-generated description omits the scale type (linear).
The reference description states the categories are arranged in a logical order, while the machine-generated description incorrectly claims there is no specific ordering rule.
